integrity: All mathematical assertions and asymptotic quantifiers are supplied with a self-contained analytic derivation and separate reproducible rational test script. Priority assessment is limited to individually identified source material; no independent confirmation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact cone is limited to the two-harmonic multiplicative cosine modulation of a circle heat kernel, for each fixed positive heat time. The oldest specialized theta-function covariance literature has not been exhaustively examined; an equivalent earlier classification remains possible. Numerical calculations only supplement the analytic proof.
title: A countably faceted positivity frontier for quadratically modulated circle heat kernels
